title: Power and Control Awareness
description: This course helps participants understand how power, control, and dominance can appear in relationships and how these behaviours create harm.
learningOutcomes: Identify behaviours rooted in power and control.
Understand how control affects partners, family members, and children.
Recognise subtle and overt forms of dominance.
Develop strategies for equitable, respectful interactions.

modules.title: Understanding Power Dynamics
modules.content: Explores how power operates in relationships.

modules.title: Forms of Control
modules.content: Identifies emotional, financial, social, and physical control.

modules.title: Building Respectful Equality
modules.content: Provides tools for shared decision-making and fairness.
